handoff_summary: The VoiceCastingPlan passes all four pillar checks and all decisions-log checks. It covers 39 lines for TED, ARTHUR and DANIEL, with profiles matching the three canon casting notes, no real-person references, and distinct voices by timbre, pace and age. Line wording matches the canon sample lines, with only bracketed delivery tags added, and no line has timer wording, supernatural confirmation, banned player address, a Ted mention of the ship, or new outpost detail.
